expectation: Cytoplasmic fibrous stain in smooth muscle, myofibroblasts and pericytes. It should line vessel walls, form the muscularis layers of gut, and sit as thin stromal sheaths. Epithelium should be negative.
observed: A: yellow marks the thick muscle wall (striated bundles), muscularis mucosae lines, and many ring-shaped vessel profiles in stroma. Epithelial crypts and villi are blue only. B and C: epithelium is negative. D: bright fibrous layers wrap a vessel wall, with nuclei outside the signal.
why: Signal follows smooth muscle layers and vessel walls, epithelium is negative, and the stain is fibrous and cytoplasmic as expected.
